cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.26)
project(VectorPerf LANGUAGES C CXX)
enable_testing()
set(CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM 3.5 CACHE STRING "Legacy vendored CMake compatibility")
set(BUILD_C_BINDINGS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_TOOLS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_PYTHON_BINDINGS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_ZVEC_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_ZVEC_AILEGO_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_ZVEC_CORE_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ZVEC_ENABLE_LTO OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${ZVEC_SOURCE_DIR}" zvec EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
foreach(name system_search pool_workloads)
  add_executable(vector_${name} "${name}.cc")
  target_compile_features(vector_${name} PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
  target_include_directories(vector_${name} PRIVATE "${ZVEC_SOURCE_DIR}/src/include" "${ZVEC_SOURCE_DIR}/src")
  target_link_libraries(vector_${name} PRIVATE -Wl,--whole-archive zvec_core zvec_turbo zvec_ailego -Wl,--no-whole-archive)
endforeach()
add_library(vector_alloc_probe SHARED alloc_probe.c)
find_package(Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter REQUIRED)
add_test(NAME vector_perf_harness_smoke
  COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/smoke.py" "$<TARGET_FILE:vector_system_search>")
add_executable(vector_alloc_probe_test alloc_probe_test.c)
target_compile_options(vector_alloc_probe_test PRIVATE -fno-builtin -UNDEBUG)
target_link_libraries(vector_alloc_probe_test PRIVATE dl pthread)
add_test(NAME vector_alloc_probe_test
  COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E env "LD_PRELOAD=$<TARGET_FILE:vector_alloc_probe>" "$<TARGET_FILE:vector_alloc_probe_test>")
